options.label: fastest completion
options.rule: Complete the game as fast as possible.

This is the full completion interpretation of this game without linking to other copies of Crash Bandicoot Purple: Ripto's Rampage or Spyro Orange The Cortex Conspiracy. It requires the player to collect 25 Crystals, 25 Gems and 120 Trading Cards, which totals in a completion percentage of 104%. Use of in-game cheat codes is not allowed. Linking with other games is not allowed.
